headline: Spot Gold Falls as US Tariff Plans Reinforce Rate-Hike Expectations
summary: Spot gold declined to approximately $3,533 per ounce as White House tariff plans and cautious sentiment strengthened expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
why: Gold prices are sensitive to US real interest rates and currency strength driven by Federal Reserve monetary policy outlooks.
why_moved: Expectations of further monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve and stronger tariff-driven rate bets increase holding costs for precious metals.
